title: Set up measured outreach: 341 connects across 109 business units
summary: In my first half-year in software excellence I designed a connect format and ran 341 connects, sessions and mentoring conversations with 236 people across 109 business units, 52 roles and 25 programming languages. I tracked every one so the results could feed the team's KPIs.
what_would_have_happened: A central excellence team would have waited for teams to come to it.
the_call: Go to the teams, and measure reach and feedback like a product.
what_i_did: Designed the connect format, tracked every interaction and collected presenter and mentor ratings.
what_changed: Reach across India, Shanghai, Brazil and the Netherlands; the data fed the team's KPIs.

quotes.text: Please continue these sessions and I would like to see Design related sessions.
